shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,220p' package.json && sed -n '1,240p' next.config.ts && sed -n '1,260p' app/layout.tsx && sed -n '1,300p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,320p' app/ProductGrid.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' app/ProductSkeleton.tsx && sed -n '1,340p' 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' && sed -n '1,420p' app/globals.css"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '210,380p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.next/*' -print | sort && sed -n '1,240p' tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,260p' lib/products.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- package.json && git show HEAD:package.json && rg -n \"type ViewTransition|interface ViewTransition|ViewTransitionProps|export.*ViewTransition\" node_modules/@types/react node_modules/react -g '*.d.ts' -g '*.js' | sed -n '1,240p' && sed -n '1,260p' __agent_eval__/run.mjs"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,145p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts && rg -n \"reference types=\\\"react/canary|react/canary\" . -g '*.d.ts' -g '*.json' -g '*.ts' -g '*.tsx' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!.next'"' && rg -n \"ViewTransition\" node_modules/next/types node_modules/next -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,200p'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"react/canary\" next-env.d.ts .next/types 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,120p'; sed -n '1,80p' next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null; node -e \"import('react').then(r=>console.log({version:r.version,vt:typeof r.ViewTransition,att:typeof r.addTransitionType}))\""

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'react\\"'$|react-dom'"\\"'$|next/dist/compiled/react|vendored/contexts|ViewTransition'"' node_modules/next/dist/build node_modules/next/dist/server node_modules/next/dist/client -g '*.js' | sed -n '1,260p' && node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\" && npm ls react react-dom next --depth=1"

/bin/bash -lc "node - <<'NODE'
const paths=[
'next/dist/compiled/react',
'next/dist/compiled/react-experimental',
'next/dist/server/route-modules/app-page/vendored/rsc/react',
'next/dist/server/route-modules/app-page/vendored/ssr/react'
]
for(const p of paths){try{const r=require(p);console.log(p,r.version,typeof r.ViewTransition)}catch(e){console.log(p,e.code)}}
NODE
sed -n '275,335p' node_modules/next/dist/build/create-compiler-aliases.js
sed -n '640,685p' node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js
rg -n \"bundledReactChannel\" node_modules/next/dist/build -g '*.js' | sed -n '1,100p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,360p' 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' && sed -n '1,260p' app/ProductGrid.tsx && tail -n +1 app/globals.css | sed -n '1,520p' && npx tsc --noEmit"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- app/ProductGrid.tsx app/page.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' app/globals.css react-canary.d.ts tsconfig.json && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && npx tsc --noEmit && git diff --stat && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D /tmp/gallery-headers http://localhost:3000/ -o /tmp/gallery-home.html && curl -sS -D /tmp/product-headers http://localhost:3000/product/classic-sneakers -o /tmp/gallery-product.html && sed -n '1,12p' /tmp/gallery-headers && sed -n '1,12p' /tmp/product-headers && rg -o \"product-image-classic-sneakers|nav-forward|nav-back|suspense-fade-(in|out)|Classic Sneakers|Back to products\" /tmp/gallery-home.html /tmp/gallery-product.html | sort | uniq -c"
